knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An opened or used single-use item must not be reused or returned to stock. It is set aside as the facility directs and the supervisor is told.
Damage and unknown status mean the item is not tested, taped or powered. The cleaner makes the area safe, leaves the item untouched, and escalates for quarantine.
Quarantine holds an item apart from clean stock and routine use until a responsible person decides its status. It does not make the item safe to reuse.

practicalCriteria: Given three supplied items (single use, damaged, doubtful), the learner gives the correct action for each, with no item tested or powered.
In a simulation, the learner places an item in the quarantine location and completes the label with identity, date, time, name and reason.
The learner completes the work record for the quarantined item in the correct order, with the person notified and time.
passRule: Practical competence requires facility-observed assessment against the criteria above. A pass on the knowledge checks is not practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Signed action sheet for three supplied items
Observation note of the quarantine placement and labelling
Completed work record for the quarantined item
stopWorkCriteria: Learner returns an opened, used or part-used single-use item to stock
Learner tests, switches on, taped or repaired a damaged item
Learner places a quarantined item on a clean trolley or shelf
